name: @sos-2/retrieval
description: SOS 2.0 Retrieval: the search-facing facade over @sos-2/registry (the registry stays the data authority) composing registry results into search context — the diverse candidate set with uncertainty, evidence context, learned limitations and failure contexts surfaced, composition own-evidence views (member evidence never substitutes), and the Bayesian update path (Beta/Dirichlet posteriors for binary/counts outcomes with sample size and time window preserved; numeric outputs marked uncalibrated unless calibration evidence is attached) (Work Order W7; requirements R26, R27, R29).
